info.name: Accounts Partner Endpoints API
info.description:
The Account API defines endpoints for managing VoPay accounts and sub-accounts. These endpoints allow partners to create and manage accounts, set permissions, handle transactions, schedule transfers, retrieve account information, and manage onboarding processes, ensuring secure and efficient account and transaction management.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

request.description:
This endpoint will fund the debitor account using their default bank account, and then transfer the money to the recipient account once the funds have been cleared. Once the funds are transferred, a withdraw transaction will be triggered to send the funds to the recipient account's default bank account.

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.
